scope: Read-only source review of mutable candidate. No real dm-cache allocation, mount, execution or production change. Findings require terminal source recheck; no claim runtime reproduced.

findings.finding: Rendered assemble accepts any existing dmsetup NAME and any mount at MNT without checking table, origin/cache device identities, writethrough mode or mounted source. A stale/mismatched mapping can defeat storage placement and cache-loss assumptions.
findings.requested: Verify owned mapping exact backing devices, size and cache mode plus mounted device before reuse; refuse mismatches. Do not detach or alter an unrelated existing mapping.

findings.finding: drop-cache removes mapper but never invalidates cache metadata. It tells operator reattach rewarms from empty, which source does not establish. Accessing/modifying origin without updating cache can later serve stale cached sectors.
evidence: re-run assemble to reattach (dm-cache rewarms from empty)
findings.requested: Define a safe cache loss/rejoin protocol. Require offline holder, validate ownership, invalidate/reset metadata safely before reuse after uncached origin changes; never automatically reattach stale cache. Keep read-only drill distinct from actual loss/rebuild.

findings.finding: otherNvmeCacheAllocations is declarative bytes only. verify-cap checks those constants and holder image blocks, not actual other caches. This does not yet prove aggregate cap enforcement or account for backing filesystem metadata and retained image copies.
findings.requested: Document evidence limit; root activation must use one shared reservation/inventory with enforced bounds and account for backing overhead/temp/spill. No allocation until actual aggregate inventory and boundary proof. Source config arithmetic alone is insufficient.

findings.finding: create formats origin before validating cache path/capacity; assemble may attach loops and fail without ownership-aware unwind. disassemble ignores unmount and dm removal failure then attempts loop detach.
findings.requested: Preflight all resources before creating; track only newly owned resources and unwind on errors without disturbing preexisting resources. Refuse to proceed after failed unmount/remove. Test interrupted and partial setup through command seams plus real bounded drill only when authorized/resources ready.
